text:
nina: PSA: muffin jar on the counter is turning into a mystery bakery. found 6 different flavors this morning :eyes:

ryan: lol which shelf? I put blueberry in there yesterday but that's not mine today.

mike: guilty pleasure confession: stole a cranberry one at 10:30. 100% not sorry. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

kitchen-bot: inventory ping: communal muffins = 6, sugar packets = 12, espresso beans = low. Update at https://redwood.internal/kitchen-inventory

sophia: small ask: can we have a "muffin map" sticky note on the jar indicating baker name/date? saves guesswork and allergy hazards.

nina: agreed. also note: espresso machine rota is confusing  two people set it to single-shot mode for the team and we ended up with sad weak americanos.

ryan: that was probably me, I forgot to flip back from testing. my bad.

mike: proposal: quick schedule, 2-week espresso steward (keeps beans, grinds, and mode). steward gets the "Coffee Hero" sticker.

sophia: vote: :hand: for steward rota, :zzz: for free-for-all.

nina: :hand: steward sounds great. I'll take week 1 next month.

facilities: will print small "Coffee Steward" sticker and a sign with preferred machine settings. also ordering a spare bag of medium roast (arrives in 3 days).

ryan: I'll add a tiny "muffin map" label template to the printer queue so bakers can sign the jar.

mike: also, can we get a tiny box of disposable tongs? saves people using fingers.

facilities: adding tongs and a small sign to the supply order. ETA 5 business days.

nina: outcome: muffin map + steward rota + tongs + spare beans. thanks all. if you took someone else's muffin, please leave a note so we can track flavors. :laughing:
